notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (B2B revenue automation) evaluating Redwood for SDR/sales agent layer. Primary want: low-latency streaming for interactive agents + secure tool calling into CRM/email/calendar.
- Started with hosted API evaluation; AE demo 2024-11-20 (streaming, function calls demo). SE demo 2024-12-02 covered batching/throughput.
POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week hosted POC integrating 3 routes: inbox triage -> summarize + classify; outbound agent -> draft + send/email suggestions + CRM update; calendar scheduling via tool call.
- KPI: 95p latency for token streaming < 200ms end-to-end for interactive flows; p95 request-to-first-token < 250ms for 99% of demo traffic.
Security/compliance notes:
- They require SSO (SAML), audit logging of tool calls, KMS-managed keys for any persisted KV cache. Legal asked for DPA and SCCs.
Pricing/ops:
- Interested in hosted API to move fast, then Dedicated for predictable throughput once traffic hits sustained spikes. Price sensitivity noted around outbound volume (many tokens/day). Wants dedicated pricing comparison (committed capacity) vs pay-as-you-go.
Quotes from calls:
- "We need the agent to feel instantaneous — anything >300ms and reps complain." — Head of Product
- "Tool calls must be auditable and the tokens stored only transiently." — Security lead
Outstanding questions / follow-ups:
- SE to run a synthetic 100 tps load test against hosted stack to validate p95 latency with streaming enabled.
- AE to send a two-option pricing: hosted monthly estimate + 12-month Dedicated commit with burst.
- Legal to get Security FAQ + DPA; Redwood to confirm KMS/HSM integrations and retention controls.
